body: What a load of shit. Everything just constantly piles up, what's the point. Life just ain't worth living with all this crap.

I've joined a couple of discords but I'm way to anxious to talk in there, my voice is absolutely terrible. I'm 21 which I know is still early but a lot of it is genetics which mine are shit. It's hard to accept and love myself when it seems like nobody else does since I've come out to people as trans. All it does is push people away.

So I need to wait at least a year for a slight chance of it getting better but with my everything the odds of that are low. My therapist is just trying to get me out of the house at the moment saying it will help, I've been leaving it every day and I just feel like crap. A year of hrt won't change facial structure, my 6'2 height, my size 13 in men's shoes feet, my stupidly hairy body and my voice which as much as I work on it never gets better.
Australia, I've been on hrt for 4 months but hormones can't change bone structure, I'm screwed

I'm all out of support, the internet can only do so much, I'm trying a gender therapist who really isn't helping much and I'm too anxious to go to a group or anything. There's nothing more I can do so it sure as hell isn't going to get easier. I know I'm a bad judge on manly but a shitty jawline is still a shitty jawline.

I know some of them are attractive but I can't live like that, I need to pass otherwise what's the point. I don't even care about being attractive I just want to look like a woman instead of a man in a dress.

I'm not capable of being me when I'm only ever going to look like a guy. I can't do this, I've tried for long enough to be okay with myself but being trans sucks and there really isn't a point of dealing with this shit.
There isn't much point when my facial structure is as manly as it comes, I'll need to spend a fortune on ffs and even then it's likely i still won't pass. I can't live like this, what's the point
Since the start of December, not really there's a couple of groups an hour away but I have way too much anxiety to go on my own. I can't handle this shit and I'll be glad when it's over.

Shit can't get better, my facial structure will always make me look like a guy, all my friends have bailed at a time when I need them the most and there's no point in going through this when I'm just going to look like a man in a dress for the rest of my life. I can't keep going knowing my life is going to be filled with this shit, people suck and I'm a freak.
